name: browser.request_inputrequest_input
description:
Ask the main agent for a required cart review, information or a decision you need to continue, and wait for the answer.

Check your instructions, earlier answers and the page first. Use this for the cart review your checkout instructions require. Other questions should concern a fact the task depends on that you cannot find, such as what a granted file holds, a choice your assignment leaves open that would change what the <!-- personal-muse-only:start -->user<!-- personal-muse-only:end --><!-- group-muse-only:start -->group<!-- group-muse-only:end --> gets, or how to pay when nothing on hand can. Payment and sign-in calls ask the main agent automatically after a <!-- personal-muse-only:start -->user<!-- personal-muse-only:end --><!-- group-muse-only:start -->member<!-- group-muse-only:end --> declines approval and return its answer; use this tool if that answer needs clarification. Deciding which listing or page matches your assignment is part of your work, not a question for the main agent. Ask independent questions together. Give the main agent the open question, the available choices, and what you have already found or tried, and label it with `reason` when a label fits. The main agent replies from what it knows of the <!-- personal-muse-only:start -->user's<!-- personal-muse-only:end --><!-- group-muse-only:start -->group's<!-- group-muse-only:end --> request, or settles it with the <!-- personal-muse-only:start -->user<!-- personal-muse-only:end --><!-- group-muse-only:start -->group<!-- group-muse-only:end -->, and the reply returns to this call.

Only ask about a one-time code when a sign-in waits on a code the site sent to the <!-- personal-muse-only:start -->user's<!-- personal-muse-only:end --><!-- group-muse-only:start -->group's<!-- group-muse-only:end --> email or phone. If you have `login.advance`, its code step gets the code from the <!-- personal-muse-only:start -->user's<!-- personal-muse-only:end --><!-- group-muse-only:start -->group's<!-- group-muse-only:end --> mail or from the main agent and enters it, so ask here only when that step cannot. Name the sender, the destination the site shows and the current step, and the main agent fetches it through a protected route. Once <!-- personal-muse-only:start -->the user<!-- personal-muse-only:end --><!-- group-muse-only:start -->a member<!-- group-muse-only:end --> approves the code, the answer gives you the code itself to type; otherwise it says the <!-- personal-muse-only:start -->user<!-- personal-muse-only:end --><!-- group-muse-only:start -->member<!-- group-muse-only:end --> declined or the code expired. Do not ask for a password or a payment approval; the login service and the payment approval handle those. The checkout agent can obtain a card from a connected wallet after payment approval.

question.description: The information or decision needed to continue.

context.description: Only the task facts needed to answer.

reason.description: The kind of information or decision needed from the main agent.
